newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Hansapank jumps in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Hansapank jumps in moderate trade.

text.p: Leading stock Hansapank dominated a bullish market and reached highs last seen in January of around 190 kroons on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index gained 1.98 percent to close at 192.69 on a turnover of 30.2 million kroons on the official list.
Hansapank was the most active stock on volume of 18.5 million kroons as it closed up 4.60 kroons at 190.05 kroons.
"Hansapank is the market indicator 50 percent of the time and this is reflected in the rise of Hansapank's stock prices now", said one dealer.
"Confidence in the market is what is driving stock prices," he added.
Tallinna pank rose slightly to close up 0.35 kroons on 59.85 kroons, registering trade of 3.9 million kroons.
Other bank stocks also strengthened. Savings Bank was 2.75 kroons stronger after finishing on 93.00 kroons and turning over 3.6 million kroons.
Forekspank advanced 0.58 kroons to close at 59.85 kroons after a trade of 2.8 million kroons of shares.
The least active of the banking stocks was Union Bank with a turnover 1.3 million kroons as it ended 0.20 kroons higher at 38.45 kroons.
The over-the-counter market was very slow with a mere 2.9 million kroons of shares traded.
Rakvere meat plant traded most shares with 1.9 million kroons of stocks changing hands to firm slightly by 0.20 kroon at 13.20 kroons.
